build_SeqLSTM_sequence_embeddings: build a SeqLSTM module to embed DAG job scheduling inputs as a sequence using PyTorch LSTM
build_DagLSTM_dag_embeddings: build a DagLSTM module to embed DAG structures using custom LSTM gates with parent-child aggregation
test_SeqLSTM_calc_embedding: test the SeqLSTM calc_embedding method to compute node states from a batch of dag_managers
test_DagLSTM_calc_embedding: test the DagLSTM calc_embedding method to compute node states by traversing the DAG top-down from the root
test_DagLSTM_update_embedding: test the DagLSTM update_embedding method to recompute node states for a subset of nodes specified by init_queues
